title: Restore production CSS/design-system rendering

root_cause.summary: Stale/mixed Next.js runtime on :3000: HTML referenced development CSS path `/_next/static/css/app/layout.css` which returned 404. `.next` had been overwritten by a later `next dev` after a successful `next build`, so manifests pointed at missing app/layout.css while only hashed production CSS files existed on disk.

ops_actions: npm run start on 127.0.0.1:3001 (port 3000 held by unkillable PID 18240 Access Denied)

port_blocker.issue: Access denied when terminating; still serves broken/stale responses including CSS 404
port_blocker.user_action: Kill PID 18240 in an elevated terminal, then: cd apps/web && npm run start -- -p 3000 -H 127.0.0.1

validation.backend_8000: unrelated to CSS; do not conflate
